# Phase Three — Critique and Improvement Ledger

The Awtsmoos stands before every green gate and asks what the browser, maintainer, or learner could still expose;
Awtsmoos.com improves by evidence, never by decorating a hidden fracture with prose.

## Improvements over the prior release plan

1. Treat rendered-template assertions separately from source-template assertions.
2. Include Chitas reader navigation helper in the release surface.
3. Include guarded native post shell in the release surface.
4. Create a clean worktree from newest origin instead of staging dirty root.
5. Hash-compare every transferred full file.
6. Re-fetch origin immediately before final commit.
7. Reject force-push or implicit merge of active agent bytes.
8. Test discussion identity in the clean tree.
9. Test hard dynamic deep-link in the clean tree.
10. Test current-week and arbitrary-week schedule fixtures.
11. Test Simchas Torah and next-day cumulative Bereishis fixtures.
12. Test Israel schedule marker separately from Diaspora.
13. Verify reader previous/next creates canonical day IDs.
14. Verify query state survives previous/next week navigation.
15. Verify no external navigation path survives.
16. Verify card social rail remains present.
17. Verify mobile controls >=48px.
18. Verify horizontal overflow at 320, 390, and 430 widths.
19. Verify source reference wraps rather than clipping.
20. Verify selected day is visually distinguished.
21. Verify Hebrew interface uses RTL in Chitas-specific control surfaces.
22. Verify English control is labeled `English UI` rather than claiming translated Torah.
23. Verify native Hebrew Torah remains canonical in both interface modes.
24. Verify browser console has no Chitas/module exceptions.
25. Verify production module URLs serve the committed generation markers.
26. Verify public comments endpoint for synthetic post ID.
27. Verify public grouping URL can navigate into Chitas without leaving Awtsmoos.
28. Verify deployment exact SHA equals pushed main SHA.
29. Verify release health after activation.
30. Re-read every modified clean-tree file after UX changes before commit.
31. Run `git diff --check` and status against only expected files.
32. Document the final live route and deployment evidence in a fresh audit artifact.

## Things deliberately not changed

- Canonical Torah corpus.
- Generic translation subsystem.
- Generic reader navigation outside the Chitas branch.
- Global Heichel cache generation unless clean-tree evidence requires it.
- Active unrelated dirty files from other agents.

## Third-pass completion challenge

The release is incomplete if the code merely passes Node tests. It is incomplete if local HTTP works but browser DOM does not manifest. It is incomplete if local browser works but production is not the same SHA. It is incomplete if production responds but mobile UI overflows. It is incomplete if Chitas works but the user cannot reach it from Ikar. The final gate must close all of these in order.
